resources.string: Lets AutoTap perform the taps at your chosen dots. No screen reading — only gesture output.

1. Grant both permissions above.
2. Tap "Show floating controls" — a small bubble appears over every app.
3. Tap the bubble to open the menu. Add dots and drag each one to where you want taps.
4. Set the speed (CPS).
5. Toggle mode: press START to click continuously (keeps going if you collapse the menu).
6. Hold mode: press and hold the HOLD pad to click; let go to stop. Collapsing the menu stops hold-clicking.

Dots become tap-through while clicking, so move them while clicking is stopped.
